mythology: During the dismemberment of Sati's remains by Vishnu's chakra, the toes of her right foot fell at this sacred bend of the Bhagirathi/Adi Ganga river.
pilgrimage_significance: One of the most potent Kali kshetras in India, drawing millions of pilgrims seeking spiritual awakening, protection, and fulfillment of vows.
historical_notes: Celebrated in medieval Bengali texts such as Mansar Bhashan (15th century) and Chandi Mangal; gave its name to the city of Kolkata.
